pages.text: Dynamo Ventures led a $4M seed round in a freight visibility startup this week. "We see a long overdue shift to software in freight forwarding," said a partner at Dynamo Ventures. Jane Partner, General Partner, led the deal. Jane Partner, General Partner, led the deal.
